about_the_game:
Description:

Dive into the darkness with "Blood Moon Horror," a thrilling 1-8 player, online cooperative psychological horror experience. Navigate through the eerie shadows with your friends, evading alien predators and uncovering dark secrets in an unforgettable adventure.

Evolving Threats:

Face off against a terrifying enemy already lurking in the shadows, with two more fiendish foes currently in development.

Thrilling Multiplayer Co-op:

Join forces in a spine-chilling cooperative experience. Rally your friends, test your bonds, and overcome the horrors together.

Survival and Exploration:

Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of the moon base, where every corner hides danger. Scavenge for resources, find clues, and unravel the mystery of the alien infestation while staying one step ahead of your extraterrestrial hunters.

Procedurally Generated Base:

Experience a unique layout each time you play with a procedurally generated moon base. Every playthrough offers new challenges and secrets to uncover.

Adaptive AI:

Encounter intelligent alien hunters that adapt to your strategies. No two encounters are the same, keeping you on edge throughout your journey.

Immersive First-Person Horror:

Step into an intense, first-person psychological horror adventure. Explore a narrative-rich world, filled with tension and dread, that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Ready to face the terror of the night?

Wishlist "Blood Moon Horror" on Steam now and prepare for an unforgettable journey into fear with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed.

Stay connected and join our community on Discord for the latest updates and discussions!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 ti | AMD R9 380 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60 FPS for Medium settings (With no Upscaling)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz | AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 | AMD RX 470 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60 FPS for High settings (With no Upscaling)
